visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white T-shirt and grey joggers with a grey sweater tied around his waist, walks along a grey-walled storefront labeled "MAQPRO". The setting is an urban alleyway in daylight with natural lighting. (2) He enters the store; the interior is brightly lit with warm studio lights and features wooden shelving units stocked with makeup products. He stands beside a woman with long dark hair wearing a white mesh top and black pants. They both face the camera, smiling and gesturing with their hands. (3) The camera focuses on various makeup products: an eyeshadow palette with vibrant primary colors and a concealer palette with various skin tones. A close-up shows the man's hand with multiple cream-colored swatches. (4) Close-up shots of circular makeup containers being opened. The man's hand demonstrates the texture of a shimmery eye gloss and a cream blush on his skin. (5) Transition to a different section of the store showing a grid of circular blush pans in many shades. (6) The video shows other brands on shelves like "too beauty" and "Lily Lolo". (7) The man is seen in a makeup studio area with long white tables, mirrors, and professional ring lights. (8) Final shot of the man and woman waving and gesturing "peace" signs toward the camera in a selfie-style perspective.
